content.cohort_summary: 2017-2018 Chevrolet Express/GMC Savana 2500 cargo vans, FL/Southeast, 51k-164k miles.

source_platform_analysis.evidence_summary: Archived Proxibid catalogs show hammer prices for comparable fleet vans.
source_platform_analysis.observed_value_pattern: Running fleet vans with cosmetic wear cleared $700-2,600 in recent regional sales.
source_platform_analysis.influence_on_auction_range: Moderate — small sample size but directly on-platform.

commercial_market.rationale: Asking prices on CommercialTruckTrader for comparable Express/Savana 2500 vans in this mileage band.

fleet_auction_market.rationale: JJ Kane archived catalog hammer prices for comparable fleet vehicles.

mileage_patterns.observed_pattern: Higher end of the auction range.
mileage_patterns.rationale: Lower-mileage comparables cleared closer to the top of the range.

representative_comparables.condition_notes: Runs and moves, interior wear consistent with fleet use.
representative_comparables.relevance_notes: Same source platform, comparable year and mileage.

content.research_summary: Fleet-auction clearing values run well below commercial asking prices for this cohort.
